name: 4-HO-PiPT
summary: 4-HO-PiPT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-propyl-N-isopropyltryptamine or as piprocin, is a substituted tryptamine derivative which is claimed to have psychedelic effects. It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-PiPT acts as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, with an EC50 of 13.8 nM and an efficacy of 104.8%.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its two nitrogen chains, propyl and isopropyl, contain exactly the same number of atoms but are shaped differently: one is straight and the other branches in the middle.
fact.zh: 它氮原子上的兩條鏈，丙基與異丙基，原子數量完全相同，形狀卻不一樣：一條是直鏈，另一條在中間分岔。
fact.zhHans: 它氮原子上的两条链，丙基与异丙基，原子数量完全相同，形状却不一样：一条是直链，另一条在中间分岔。
